{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
print("Number of rows with conversion errors:", sales_df['revenue_numeric'].isnull().sum())

# Now, filter to only 'completed' orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of completed orders
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed_orders))

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the result
print("Mean revenue of completed orders:", mean_revenue_completed)"}
